words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me.
words.ex_cn: 慢速的网络让我感到沮丧。
words.en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to deal with the problems it creates.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.tr: adj. 有才华的；有天赋的；
words.ex: He is a gifted musician who plays piano beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有才华的音乐家，钢琴弹得非常优美。
words.en: Having a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: The village was stricken by a sudden flood.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄遭受了一场突如其来的洪水。
words.en: If a person or place is stricken by something such as an unpleasant feeling, an illness, or a natural disaster, they are severely affected by it.

words.ex: He gave a sniff of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他闻了闻那朵花。
words.en: To sniff is to breathe in air through your nose in a way that makes a noise, especially when you are trying to smell something or when you have a cold.

words.ex: He walked backwards to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走到门边。
words.en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.ex: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 给汤里加一点盐。
words.en: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly. A dash is a straight, horizontal line used in writing, for example to separate two main clauses whose meanings are closely connected.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: He simply wants to go home.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想回家。
words.en: In a simple manner; without much complexity or difficulty.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.tr: v. 吹；刮风；浪费；“blow” 的过去式
words.ex: He blew out the candles on his cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吹灭了蛋糕上的蜡烛。
words.en: To blow means to move air or to cause air to move, especially in a way that is noticeable or strong.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: The liberation of the city ended the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的解放结束了战争。
words.en: Liberation refers to the act of setting someone free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression; release.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: He packed his clothes into a suitcase.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服装进了行李箱。
words.en: A suitcase is a case with a handle and often with wheels, used for carrying clothes and possessions when travelling.

words.tr: v. 成长；种植；养成；变得；“grow”的过去式；
words.ex: The tree grew tall near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在房子附近长高了。
words.en: Grew is the past tense of grow, which means to increase in size or amount, or to become something different.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The knight held a sharp sword in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手里拿着一把锋利的剑。
words.en: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard, used for thrusting or striking and now typically worn as part of ceremonial dress.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The detective solved the mystery with clues.
words.ex_cn: 侦探用线索破解了谜案。
words.en: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread from the grocer.
words.ex_cn: 他从杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocer is a person who sells food and small household goods.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: n. 女售货员；女营业员
words.ex: The salesgirl helped me find a red dress.
words.ex_cn: 女售货员帮我找到了一件红色连衣裙。
words.en: A salesgirl is a young woman whose job is to sell goods in a shop.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.tr: adj. 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的； v. “frighten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 孩子被巨大的噪音吓到了。
words.en: If you are frightened, you are anxious or afraid, often because of something that has just happened or that you think may happen.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: She stirred the vegetables in the wok.
words.ex_cn: 她在炒锅里搅拌蔬菜。
words.en: A wok is a large bowl-shaped pan used for cooking, especially in Chinese cuisine. It is typically made of metal and has a rounded bottom and high sides, which make it ideal for stir-frying.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: He wrote, 'I love apples, bananas, and oranges.'
words.ex_cn: 他写道：'我喜欢苹果、香蕉和橙子。'
words.en: A comma is a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate a pause or to separate items in a list.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他的包里有三十本书。
words.en: The number 30.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.tr: n. 绘画；油画； v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves painting in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间绘画。
words.en: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: He watches the Olympic games every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: Relating to the Olympic Games, an international sporting event held every four years.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr: n. 滑板车；踏板车；小型摩托车
words.ex: He rides a scooter to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑滑板车去学校。
words.en: A scooter is a small motorcycle with a low seat. It is often used for short distances in urban areas.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: There is plenty of food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有充足的食物。
words.en: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.tr: n. 果菜商；蔬菜水果店
words.ex: The greengrocer sells fresh apples and carrots.
words.ex_cn: 蔬果商贩出售新鲜的苹果和胡萝卜。
words.en: A greengrocer is a person who owns or works in a shop that sells fresh vegetables and fruit.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.tr: abbr. “light-emitting diode”的缩写；发光二级管；
words.ex: The streetlights use led bulbs to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 街灯使用LED灯泡来节省能源。
words.en: Led is the past tense and past participle of lead, which means to guide or direct in a course.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: Saint Francis loved animals and helped the poor.
words.ex_cn: 圣方济各热爱动物并帮助穷人。
words.en: A saint is a person who is recognized as having an exceptional degree of holiness, likeness, or closeness to God.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The teacher gave her approval for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这个项目表示了赞成。
words.en: If you give your approval to something, you agree with it or allow it to happen.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: The climber reached the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这位登山者登上了山顶。
words.en: A climber is someone who climbs mountains or rocks as a sport or hobby, or a plant that grows upwards by clinging to a support.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.ex: The book is 10 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这本书长10英寸。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: The civilian population stayed safe during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 平民在冲突期间保持安全。
words.en: A civilian is a person who is not a member of the military or of a police or firefighting force.

words.tr: n. 甜甜圈；油炸圈饼；炸面圈
words.ex: He ate a doughnut for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个甜甜圈。
words.en: A doughnut is a small, circular cake, usually with a hole in the middle, that is fried and often covered with sugar.

words.tr: adj. 勤奋的；用功的；仔细的
words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业很勤奋。
words.en: Diligent: showing careful and persistent effort in work or study.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: The ministry of education controls schools.
words.ex_cn: 教育部管理学校。
words.en: A ministry is a government department, especially in Britain, which is responsible for a particular area of administration, such as health or education.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: The foreigner asked for directions to the train station.
words.ex_cn: 这位外国人问了去火车站的路。
words.en: A foreigner is a person who comes from a country other than your own.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.ex: He uses a blender to make smoothies.
words.ex_cn: 他用搅拌机做奶昔。
words.en: A blender is a kitchen appliance used to mix, purée, or emulsify food and other substances.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上下棋。
words.en: Chess is a board game for two players, each beginning with 16 pieces of six kinds that are moved according to specific rules, the object being to checkmate the opponent's king.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: He swallowed the pill with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药片。
words.en: To swallow means to make food or drink go down your throat and towards your stomach. It can also mean to accept something without protest or to believe something too easily.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假日去了海滩。
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: v. 跌倒；下降；砍伐；“fall”的过去式；
words.ex: He fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔了下来。
words.en: To cut down (a tree); to knock down (a person or animal); the skin of an animal with the hair or wool still on it; fierce or cruel.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.tr:
adj. 紧张的；拉紧的；
n. 时态；
words.ex: He felt tense before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张。
words.en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.tr:
adj. 俄国的；
n. 俄语；
words.ex: He loves Russian music and food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢俄罗斯的音乐和食物。
words.en: Relating to Russia, its people, or their language.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: He raised his eyebrow when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时抬起了眉毛。
words.en: An eyebrow is the line of hair that grows above your eye.

words.ex: He wears shorts to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他穿短裤去海滩。
words.en: Shorts are a piece of clothing that you wear on the lower part of your body, which do not cover your legs completely.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.tr: adj. 武装的； v. “arm”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The armed soldiers marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 武装的士兵穿过城镇。
words.en: Equipped with weapons, especially firearms.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.ex: He eats mutton for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃羊肉当晚餐。
words.en: Mutton is the meat of an adult sheep eaten as food.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.tr: adj. 破旧的；肮脏破烂的；衣衫褴褛的
words.ex: He wore a shabby coat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去学校。
words.en: If you describe something as shabby, you mean that it looks old and is in poor condition.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子打扫了地板。
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.ex: Mankind needs to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护环境。
words.en: Human beings considered collectively; the human race.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.tr: adv. 舒服地；舒适地；安逸地；
words.ex: He sat comfortably on the soft sofa.
words.ex_cn: 他舒服地坐在柔软的沙发上。
words.en: In a manner that provides physical ease and relaxation.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上起得很早。
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: He coughed loudly and covered his mouth with a tissue.
words.ex_cn: 他大声咳嗽，并用纸巾捂住嘴。
words.en: A verb meaning to criticize or reprimand someone severely, often in a harsh or humiliating manner.

words.ex: He wears a pair of sneakers to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一双运动鞋去学校。
words.en: A sneaker is a type of soft shoe that you wear for sports or as informal wear.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He ate a walnut for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一颗胡桃作为健康零食。
words.en: A walnut is the nut of the walnut tree, which has a hard, wrinkled shell and a two-lobed, edible kernel.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: The ropeway transported skiers up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条索道将滑雪者运送上山。
words.en: A ropeway is a means of transport which uses one or more ropes to move people or goods, especially across a valley or up a mountain.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: The kitten is sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 小猫正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A kitten is a very young cat.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr:
n. 圣歌；赞美诗；喊叫
v. 吟唱；诵扬；反复叫喊
words.ex: The monks sang a traditional chant during the morning prayer.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在晨祷时唱了一首传统圣歌。
words.en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again. It can also refer to a simple song, especially one that is sung in a religious service.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.ex: The bike has a shiny metal rim.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一个闪亮的金属轮圈。
words.en: The outer edge of something, especially a circular object.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: He wisely saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment or the benefit of experience.

words.tr:
n. 海狸；海狸毛皮
v. 勤奋工作
words.ex: The beaver builds a dam with sticks and mud.
words.ex_cn: 海狸用树枝和泥土筑坝。
words.en: A beaver is a large rodent with a broad, flat tail, known for building dams and lodges in rivers.

words.ex: He bought a packet of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一小包糖。
words.en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.tr: n. 惊险小说（或戏剧、电影）；
words.ex: He loves watching thriller movies at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上看惊险电影。
words.en: A thriller is a book, film, or play that tells an exciting story about something such as criminal activities or spying.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.ex: We eat supper at six o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们六点吃晚饭。
words.en: Supper is the last meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.tr: v. 转；转动；转弯；“turn”的现在分词； n. 转弯处；拐弯处；岔路口；
words.ex: He is turning the key to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正在转动钥匙开门。
words.en: A turning is a place where a road branches off another road.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 上升；“rise”的过去分词；提高；
words.ex: The sun has risen in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳已经从东方升起。
words.en: To have moved upwards or to have increased in level or amount.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: He needs to analyse the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他需要仔细分析这些数据。
words.en: To examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他读书作为一种爱好。
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: He has ten apples.
words.ex_cn: 他有十个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.tr:
n. （动词）不定式
adj. 不定式的
words.ex: The infinitive of 'run' is 'to run'.
words.ex_cn: “run”的不定式是“to run”。
words.en: The basic form of a verb, without an inflection binding it to a particular subject or tense.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: I forgive you for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我原谅你迟到了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.ex: Frankly, I don't like this idea.
words.ex_cn: 坦率地说，我不喜欢这个想法。
words.en: In a frank manner; honestly or directly.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr: adj. 卑微的；谦逊的；虚心的；
words.ex: He lived in a humble house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他住在河边一座简陋的房子里。
words.en: If you describe someone as humble, you mean that they do not think they are better or more important than other people.

words.ex: The police caught the terrorist near the station.
words.ex_cn: 警察在车站附近抓住了这名恐怖分子。
words.en: A terrorist is a person who uses violent and intimidating methods in the pursuit of political aims.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: She decided to have an abortion.
words.ex_cn: 她决定进行流产。
words.en: An abortion is a medical procedure to end a pregnancy so it does not result in the birth of a baby.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: He chose the red shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了红色的衬衫。
words.en: If you choose someone or something from several people or things that are available, you decide which person or thing you want to have.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.ex: The teacher gave a dictation of five sentences.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了一次五句话的听写。
words.en: Dictation is the speaking or reading aloud of words for someone else to write down.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: He stopped at the crossroads to decide which way to go.
words.ex_cn: 他在十字路口停下来，决定走哪条路。
words.en: A crossroads is a place where two roads cross each other. It can also refer to a point in time when a crucial decision must be made that will have far-reaching consequences.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.ex: The warrior threw a spear at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 战士向敌人投掷了一支矛。
words.en: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp point at one end, used for thrusting or throwing.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的现在分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school is providing free lunches to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen only if a particular condition is met.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: He brushes his teeth with a toothbrush every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用牙刷刷牙。
words.en: A toothbrush is a small brush with a long handle that you use to clean your teeth.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 广播，播放( broadcast的过去式和过去分词 ); 传播，乱传（消息等）
words.ex: The news was broadcasted on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚新闻在电视上播放了。
words.en: To transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.ex: The bomb will explode at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在中午爆炸。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

words.ex: The clock strikes precisely at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟恰好在正午敲响。
words.en: In a precise manner; exactly.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: He is an activist who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助穷人的积极分子。
words.en: An activist is a person who works to bring about political or social change by campaigning, public speaking, or demonstrating.

words.ex: She carefully wrote down the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 她仔细地记下了说明。
words.en: In a way that gives a lot of attention to what you are doing so that you do not have an accident, make a mistake, or damage something.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: Her mother gave her encouragement before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 考试前，她妈妈给了她鼓励。
words.en: Encouragement is the act of giving someone support, confidence, or hope.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.
