words.ex: He felt deep misery after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: Misery is a state of great unhappiness and emotional distress.

words.tr: adj. 上瘾了的；入了迷的
words.ex: He is addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If you are addicted to something, you cannot stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to you.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水很浑浊。
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: He gave a quick preview of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要预看了这部电影。
words.en: A preview is an opportunity to see something such as a film or a collection of works of art before it is open to the public.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: He works for an international company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家国际公司工作。
words.en: International means involving or relating to more than one country.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她为晚餐包了饺子。
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: He eats tofu for dinner every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃豆腐。
words.en: A soft, bland, white cheese-like food made from the pressed curds of soybean milk.

words.ex: His humour makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让每个人都笑起来。
words.en: Humour is the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一月。
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.ex: He became a millionaire after selling his app.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉自己的应用后成了百万富翁。
words.en: A millionaire is a person whose wealth amounts to a million or more in currency units such as dollars, pounds, or euros.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful representation of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是对自然的美丽表现。
words.en: A representation of something is a picture, a model of it, or a description of it that you create or that someone else creates for you.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr: adj. 剃光毛发的；削发的 v. 剃，刮，刨，削(shave的过去分词形式；
words.ex: The boy has a shaven head.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩剃光了头发。
words.en: If someone has a shaven head, their hair has been completely cut off so that their head is smooth.

words.tr:
n. 小伙子；家伙
v. 皲裂
words.ex: The chap helped me carry the boxes.
words.ex_cn: 那个小伙子帮我搬了箱子。
words.en: A chap is a man or boy. If something chaps your skin, it makes it sore and cracked.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: He zipped up his jacket with the zipper.
words.ex_cn: 他用拉链拉上了夹克。
words.en: A zipper is a device consisting of two strips of metal or plastic with interlocking projections closed or opened by pulling a slide along them, used to fasten openings in clothing, bags, etc.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr: v. 经历；体验；“experience”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有经验的；
words.ex: He experienced a sudden storm while hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时经历了一场突如其来的暴风雨。
words.en: Someone who is experienced has knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity because they have done it for a long time.

words.ex: He got a nosebleed after hitting his head.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到头后流鼻血了。
words.en: A nosebleed is the loss of blood from the tissue that lines the inside of your nose.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: Can you pronounce this word correctly?
words.ex_cn: 你能正确发音这个词吗？
words.en: To pronounce means to make the sound of a word or letter with your voice. It can also mean to declare or announce something officially or formally.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: v. 遭受；忍受；“suffer”的现在分词； n. 痛苦；苦难；折磨；
words.ex: He is suffering from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正遭受一场重感冒。
words.en: Suffering is the experience of mental or physical pain.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: He plugged the charger into the socket.
words.ex_cn: 他把充电器插进插座里。
words.en: A socket is a device into which an electric plug can be inserted in order to make a connection in a circuit.

words.ex: He is confined to his room because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
words.en: If you confine something or someone, you limit them to a particular place or situation.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: He swam across the lake yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天游过了湖。
words.en: Swam is the past tense of swim, which means to move through water by moving the arms and legs.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.tr:
adj. 肿胀的；上涨的
v. 膨胀；肿胀；“swell”的过去分词
words.ex: His ankle is swollen after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后脚踝肿了。
words.en: If a part of your body is swollen, it is larger and rounder than normal, usually as a result of injury or illness.

words.tr:
n. 大西洋；
adj. 大西洋的；
words.ex: The ship crossed the Atlantic in ten days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船用了十天时间穿越大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic is the ocean that lies between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

words.ex: He finished in twelfth place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第十二名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number twelve in a series.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: The boy drew a big dragon on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在他的笔记本上画了一条大龙。
words.en: A mythical monster like a giant reptile. In European tradition, it is typically fire-breathing and tends to symbolize chaos or evil, whereas in East Asia it is usually a beneficent symbol of fertility, associated with water and the heavens.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 韵文；
v. 押韵；
words.ex: The poem has a simple rhyme.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗有一段简单的韵文。
words.en: A rhyme is a repetition of similar sounds in the final stressed syllables and any following syllables of two or more words, most often used in poetry.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是灰色的。
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.tr:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木；使迟钝
words.ex: His fingers felt numb after being in the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指在寒冷中变得麻木。
words.en: If a part of your body is numb, you cannot feel it, usually for a short time.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The lid is tight on the jar.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Something that is tight is fastened or fixed firmly and is not loose.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: My brother plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.tr: adj. 泥泞的；模糊不清的；
words.ex: The road became muddy after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，这条路变得泥泞。
words.en: If something is muddy, it is covered in mud or full of mud. If you muddy something, you make it muddy or you make it less clear or more complicated.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.tr: n. 跳舞；舞蹈； v. 跳舞；“dance”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dancing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 跳舞是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: the activity of moving your body in time to music

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.ex: He watched the game closely.
words.ex_cn: 他紧密地观看了比赛。
words.en: In a way that is very near in space or time; with little or no space or time in between.

words.ex: I have seen that movie before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前看过那部电影。
words.en: If you have seen something, you have observed it through your eyes or understood it.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: The porter carried his bags to the taxi.
words.ex_cn: 行李搬运工把他的行李搬到了出租车上。
words.en: A porter is a person whose job is to carry things, especially travelers' luggage at places such as railway stations or hotels.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: The church is a holy place.
words.ex_cn: 教堂是一个神圣的地方。
words.en: If you describe something as holy, you mean that it is considered to be special because it is connected with God or a particular religion.

words.ex: The costomer bought a shirt and a hat.
words.ex_cn: 这位顾客买了一件衬衫和一顶帽子。
words.en: A misspelling of 'customer', meaning a person who buys goods or services from a business.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐的；逐步的；渐进的；
words.ex: The change was gradual.
words.ex_cn: 这种变化是逐渐的。
words.en: A gradual change or process happens in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.tr: adj. 官僚的；官僚主义的；
words.ex: The bureaucratic process made it hard to get a permit.
words.ex_cn: 官僚程序让申请许可证变得困难。
words.en: If you describe a system, organization, or process as bureaucratic, you mean that it is complicated and inefficient because of a large number of rules and procedures.

words.tr: n. 公牛；（阉割的）公牛；“ox”的复数；
words.ex: The farmers drove the oxen to plow the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民们赶着公牛去犁地。
words.en: Oxen are large, strong animals used in some countries for pulling heavy loads or for farming.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.ex: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 州长昨天签署了这项新法律。
words.en: A governor is a person who is responsible for the political administration of a region, such as a state or a colony.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: He likes apples, and similarly, his sister likes them too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，同样，他妹妹也喜欢。
words.en: in a similar way

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: He uses his cellphone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A cellphone is a telephone that does not have wires and works by radio, that you can carry with you and use anywhere.

words.tr: adj. 满意的；满足的； v. 使满意；使满足；“satisfy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他对结果感到满意。
words.en: If you are satisfied with something, you are happy because you have got what you wanted or needed.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr: v. 睡觉；“sleep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He slept well last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡得很好。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of sleep.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.ex: It has been showery all week.
words.ex_cn: 这一周一直断断续续下雨。
words.en: A showery day is one on which there are frequent short periods of rain.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.ex: He uses a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个聪明的策略赢得比赛。
words.en: A plan or method for achieving a major or overall aim; a careful, long-term plan.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.ex: She hires a babysitter to look after her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她请了一个保姆来照看她的宝宝。
words.en: A babysitter is someone who looks after children while their parents are out.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: The school is five kilometers from my house.
words.ex_cn: 学校离我家五公里。
words.en: A kilometer is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to one thousand meters.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.ex: He was born on the twentieth of May.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于五月二十日。
words.en: The twentieth item in a series is the one that you count as number twenty.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: She poured tea from a red teapot.
words.ex_cn: 她从一个红色的茶壶里倒茶。
words.en: A teapot is a container with a lid, a handle, and a spout, used for making and serving tea.

words.tr: n. 乘务员；管家；保护者
words.ex: The steward served drinks on the plane.
words.ex_cn: 空乘人员在飞机上提供饮料。
words.en: A steward is a person whose job is to look after the passengers on a ship, aircraft, or train and bring them meals. A steward is also a person who is in charge of the organization of a particular event, or who manages someone else's property.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.tr: v. 显示；表现；展示；“show”的过去分词；
words.ex: The screen shown the results clearly.
words.ex_cn: 屏幕显示了清晰的结果。
words.en: Past participle of show; to make something clear or visible to someone by looking at it or explaining it.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十月。
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: The magician pulled a rabbit from a hat.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师从帽子里变出了一只兔子。
words.en: A magician is a person who performs magic tricks to entertain people, often as part of a show.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.tr: v. 醒来；唤起；“awake”的过去式
words.ex: He awoke early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早醒来赶公交车。
words.en: To wake up; to become conscious or aware of something.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: His smile left a good impression on me.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑给我留下了好印象。
words.en: An idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: I saw a bird fly over the house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一只鸟飞过房子。
words.en: A saw is a tool consisting of a tough blade, wire, or chain with a hard toothed edge. It is used to cut through material, very often wood, though sometimes metal or stone. The cut is made by placing the toothed edge against the material and moving it forcefully forth and less forcefully back or continuously forward.

words.ex: She put flowers in a vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把花放在桌子上的花瓶里。
words.en: A vase is a container, often used for holding cut flowers. It can be made from a variety of materials, including glass, ceramics, and metals.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；丢掷；放弃；离职
words.ex: He chucked the old book into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To throw something carelessly or casually; to give up or stop doing something.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在十二月。
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.tr: n. 沸腾；煮沸； v. 煮沸；“boil”的现在分词； adj. 很热的；
words.ex: The boiling of water happens at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水的沸腾发生在100摄氏度。
words.en: The process of heating a liquid until it begins to turn into a gas, or the state of being very hot.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He drank water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后喝了水。
words.en: The past tense of 'drink', meaning to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
n. 激浪；拍岸浪花；
v. 冲浪；（互联网上）冲浪；
words.ex: He bought a new surf for the beach trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为海滩之旅买了一块新的激浪。
words.en: To surf means to ride on the crest of a wave towards the shore, typically on a surfboard. It can also mean to browse the internet.

words.tr: adj. 诚实的；正直的；坦率的；
words.ex: He gave an honest answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师给出了一个诚实的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as honest, you mean that they always tell the truth, and do not try to deceive people or break the law.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: She mourns her dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都在哀悼她的狗。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or regret for someone or something.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr:
n. 风味；味道；
v. 给…添风味；
words.ex: This ice cream has a sweet flavour.
words.ex_cn: 这种冰淇淋有甜美的风味。
words.en: Flavour is the taste of a food or drink, especially when it is pleasant and distinctive.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: They equally share the housework.
words.ex_cn: 他们同样分担家务。
words.en: In a manner that is the same in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: The country faced unrest after the election.
words.ex_cn: 选举后，这个国家陷入了动荡。
words.en: A state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation, typically involving public demonstrations or disorder.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.ex: The fire left ash on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 火在地面上留下了灰烬。
words.en: the powdery residue left after the burning of a substance

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: He practices Buddhism every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上修行佛教。
words.en: Buddhism is a religion and philosophy based on the teachings of the Buddha, emphasizing the elimination of suffering and the attainment of enlightenment.

words.ex: He formally accepted the award at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上正式接受了奖项。
words.en: in a formal manner

words.tr: adj. 无味的；格调低的；粗俗的
words.ex: The soup is tasteless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这汤淡而无味，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something such as a remark, joke, or gesture as tasteless, you mean that it is offensive, usually because it involves sex or death and is inappropriate in the circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.ex: He will arrive shortly.
words.ex_cn: 他不久就会到。
words.en: In a short time; soon.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr:
n. 问候；迎接；致意
v. 问候；打招呼；迎接；“greet”的现在分词
words.ex: He gave me a warm greeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一个热情的问候。
words.en: A greeting is something friendly that you say or do when you meet someone.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.tr:
n. 心爱的人
adj. 亲爱的
words.ex: My darling, come here for a moment.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的，过来一下。
words.en: A person who is very much loved or liked.

words.ex: We stayed indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
words.en: If you are indoors, you are inside a building.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: He goes to the barbershop every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五去理发店。
words.en: A barbershop is a place where a barber works, where men go to have their hair cut.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: He was arrested for a serious offence.
words.ex_cn: 他因严重犯罪被逮捕。
words.en: An offence is a crime or a violation of a rule or law.

words.ex: He watches telly every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A telly is a television set.

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr:
n. 傻瓜；蠢人；
v. 愚弄；
words.ex: He is a fool for spending all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，把所有钱都花在游戏上了。
words.en: A fool is someone who behaves in a silly way without thinking or someone who is tricked into believing or doing something that is not sensible.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: The ancient tomb was filled with artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的坟墓里充满了文物。
words.en: A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried, especially a large, impressive structure.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: The stewardess served drinks to the passengers.
words.ex_cn: 空乘小姐为乘客提供了饮料。
words.en: A stewardess is a woman whose job is to look after the passengers on a ship or an airplane.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆正在剥落。
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑摩托车去上班。
words.en: A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He looked at her with suspicion.
words.ex_cn: 他带着怀疑的眼神看着她。
words.en: A feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true, especially something bad or wrong, without having proof.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: Her courage in facing danger is admirable.
words.ex_cn: 她在面对危险时表现出的勇气令人钦佩。
words.en: If you say that something is admirable, you mean that you approve of it or respect it.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: He came to school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天来学校了。
words.en: The past tense of come, meaning to move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: I went to the park with my buddy.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的同伴去了公园。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend.
